text:
ci-bot: nightly-performance-alert: p95 on rtp_canary increased ~18% vs baseline (00:03 UTC). correlated metric: kernel-selector latency and batch-coalescer saturation. tagged rollout=feat/auto-heuristic-swing

elaine: :eyes: saw the spike. any repro in staging?

paul: I rolled a staging prober at 00:20 — saw similar p95 bump on long seqs (>512). attaching quick flame snippet.

paul: ```
profile: kernel_selector::choose() hotspots
  42%  kernel_choice::{heuristic_window}
  18%  batch_coalescer::merge_stride()
  12%  kv_cache::lookup_async()
```

tomas: that matches my local runs. heuristic_window change landed in PR 3412 (auto-heuristic-swing). it relaxes tie-breaking to favor fast-path when seq variance high.

maya: CI perf runner also flagged a regression on the merge build (3412). job: https://ci.internal/build/3412 - saw latency regression in several suites.

elaine: can someone bisect between 3409..3412 to confirm the exact commit?

paul: starting bisect: `git bisect start --bad merge/3412 --good roll/3409`

ci-bot: bisect finished: culprit commit = `4a7c9e` (author: tomas) — change set includes `relax_tie_threshold` in kernel selector.

tomas: that change increases kernel-switching frequency for tail tokens; combined with batch coalescer behavior it seems to cause KV cache thrash on mid-sized workloads.

maya: repro script I used: 
```bash
./scripts/loadtest --model=gpt-lite --seq=1024 --qps=50 --duration=5m
```

ops-bot: temporary mitigation applied: feature-flag `kernel_deterministic_fallback=true` enabled in canary namespace at 01:45 UTC.

elaine: flag applied. watching metrics :bar_chart: .

paul: p95 dropped back to baseline within ~3 minutes after the flag. profiler traces show far fewer kernel handoffs and reduced kv miss rate.

tomas: agreed. proposal: revert `relax_tie_threshold` in 3412 (fast revert) and follow-up with smoother decay + prober rate cap to avoid oscillation.

maya: opened revert PR #3415 (fast) and follow-up PR #3416 (rate cap + regression tests + perf harness).

elaine: placing rollout on hold until #3415 merges and canary shows 24h stable telemetry. I'll update the release board.

paul: I'll add a deterministic perf unit test for batch_coalescer and extend nightly prober to include the loadtest pattern that tripped this.

ci-bot: incident summary: short-term mitigation = deterministic kernel fallback flag; root cause = heuristic tie-relax change increasing kernel churn leading to KV thrash; next steps = revert PR #3415, implement rate cap in #3416, add perf tests and profiler traces to nightly runs.

elaine: thanks all. follow-ups assigned. I'll close the loop after 24h stable telemetry post-revert. :white_check_mark:
